review: independent static inspection of build-only application PGO trainer
feedback_dump_context: Ordinary sigwait watcher thread, never a signal handler. Instrumented counters use -fprofile-update=atomic.
synchronization_limit: The 50ms quiet interval is a heuristic. The server main thread can remain active while feedback is dumped, so the snapshot is not guaranteed to be a globally coherent instant across all CFG counters. Atomic counter updates avoid lost-update corruption but do not prove that the main thread is parked. This is build-only approximate feedback, and profile correction plus the successful profile-use compile do not establish strict synchronization.
production_effect: Only compiler feedback/code generation; no trainer or profile-dump helper is linked into the production server.
